name: @equin/plugin-packages-process-name
description: What a process is called in Activity Monitor and ps: processName(kind, id?) spells `equin · <kind> · <id>`, and cloneNamedBinary gives an executable that name as an APFS clone (same signed bytes, a file of its own — never a hardlink), since macOS names a process by the file it executed and process.title changes nothing. Also owns the checkout's bun clone (checkoutBun), which `./equin` and the build name CLI ops and backends from.
